edit.statement: 'Is a colleague of' and 'is married to' are disjoint: no two people are both colleagues and married to each other.
edit.subject: colleague_of
edit.original: 'Is a colleague of' and 'is married to' are not disjoint: two people can be both colleagues and married to each other.
edit.scope: Whether two people who are married to each other can also be colleagues.
